newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Ieng Sary hands over German's remains. [corrected 08:02 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Ieng Sary hands over German's remains. [corrected 08:02 gmt]

text.p: Dissident Khmer Rouge leader Ieng Sary on Monday handed over the remains of German Mathias Wolf to a representative of the order of Malta's Bangkok mission, witnesses said (Corrects identity of recipient of the remains from "a diplomat from Germany's Bangkok embassy").

Ieng Sary, who was Khmer Rouge foreign minister during Pol Pot's brutal 1975-79 rule, said the 32-year-old Wolf was executed and his remains burnt after he crossed into the mountainous Phnom Malai area from Thailand. Wolf disappeared in December 1994.
